CHILL-E-PEPPER

★★★★★4.1148 reviews

CHILL-E-PEPPER is a popular fast food restaurant in Malviya Nagar, best known for its gravy momos, kurkure momos, and Indo-Chinese favorites like fried rice, noodles, and chilli potato. Customers appreciate its affordable prices and flavorful food, though the outlet is often crowded with no seating, and reviews mention inconsistent service and hygiene.
